snippet.title: Corto Promo Trailer
snippet.description:
A place appears. Tap where it is on the map. Ten seconds a question, up to 1,000 points for nailing it.

Corto is a fast geography game for iPhone and iPad. 175 map packs and 20,981 places across 12 categories: world cities, airport codes, volcanoes, football stadiums, shipwrecks, famous dishes and more. City Streets packs take you down to street level in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, London and more cities.

Challenge a friend head to head over Game Center. Invite them into any pack you own and they play it too.

Free to download with 11 packs free from day one. The rest are one-time unlocks. No ads, no subscription.
